lessons: UI and Core can expose different unit type methods. Validate actual consumers before installing listeners; failed baseline before publication installed no hooks.

A removed unit can retain a zero-charge off-map Core handle. Preserve raw events and metadata errors, supplement them with full original UI callbacks and independent actual map/entity enumeration; do not erase errors or invent a valid plot.
FindID can resolve a reused slot to a different actual unit. Identity requires actual GetID, owner and type, not a non-null handle. Historical mismatched rows remain raw evidence.

Native initialization can change the birth charge snapshot. Preserve birth3 and stable4, then pair the real4→3 charge event and exact improved plot. Do not call the initialization difference duplication.
Keep actual UI/Core yields separate; same-context before/after is a bounded yield proof. Read the native improvement table rather than guessing numeric type names.
Tool terminal output can be unavailable after actual commands. Verify exact parent absence and immutable returned records, retain null terminal exit/chunk and never replay the game action.
Partial condition restoration is not a full matrix pass. Natural population and a later acquired plot are two changes, so do not claim a one-variable prerequisite result.
Nine own listeners and all context-local test flags were retired before the one official save; normal world exit and ordinary byte verification completed.
